stories.title: Texas pharmacy recalls medications nationwide. Here's how to check yours
stories.summary: Tomball-based Greenwich Rx is recalling certain medications nationwide over sterility concerns that could put patients at risk of serious infections.

stories.title: Flying out of Houston for Thanksgiving? Here's what to know
stories.summary: Nearly 2 million travelers are expected at Houston airports this Thanksgiving. Check flight status, parking availability and tips for avoiding delays.

stories.title: Questions remain after deadly tanker crash and fire on Houston's Eastex Freeway
stories.summary: A deadly tanker fire on Houston's Eastex Freeway destroyed key clues about its cargo and prompted an inspection of the overpass.

stories.title: Trash hasn't been picked up in more than a month at this North Harris County apartment complex
stories.summary: A North Harris County apartment resident says trash hasn't been picked up in over a month, leaving dumpsters overflowing and raising sanitation concerns.

stories.title: Truck driver killed in tanker crash on Eastex Freeway at 610 Loop
stories.summary: Heavy black smoke was seen across Houston after a tanker truck overturned and caught fire on the Eastex Freeway. The truck driver was killed, HFD said.

stories.title: Mother describes finding teen unconscious as investigators probe two girls’ deaths in Aldine
stories.summary: The girls were 15 and 16. One was pronounced dead at a home, the other at an emergency clinic, according to the sheriff’s office.

stories.title: Highway 249 reopens at Breen Road after crash involving dirt bike
stories.summary: The crash closed all northbound lanes at Breen Road Tuesday evening. The roadway has since reopened.

stories.title: Houston weighs future of abandoned downtown hotel after body found inside
stories.summary: City Councilman Martinez says condemnation, acquisition and demolition are among the possibilities as the city works to address ongoing public safety concerns.

stories.title: Teen's death in e-bike crash fuels push for tougher rules in Fort Bend County
stories.summary: A 14-year-old died in an e-bike crash in Fort Bend County, where deputies have logged 159 e-bike crashes this year. Officials are pushing for new safety rules.

stories.title: Here's what a U.S. Space Academy in Houston could look like under Texas' official proposal | See the renderings
stories.summary: Texas has officially proposed Houston as the home of the U.S. Space Academy, which could begin educating its first 300 students in 2028.

stories.title: No stuffing? We find out some of the hottest takes from Thanksgiving travelers
stories.summary: Two million people traveling through Houston Airports is down compared to previous years, but these takes will turn the temperature up.

stories.title: Double homicide in Third Ward leaves 2 dead, 2 hurt, Houston police say
stories.summary: Two men were killed and two others wounded in a Houston Third Ward shooting Tuesday, police said. Officers believe it was an isolated incident.
